title: Approximate F# counts must still signal scan truncation
outcome: Approximate F# counts must still signal scan truncation
acceptance: A focused simple-mode deadline or failed-dependent regression pins that disclosure without restoring a blanket real-workspace totalIsLowerBound claim.
A simple-mode count response with a deadline, failed scan or unevaluated consumers exposes scan incompleteness separately from model approximation and retains appropriately scoped retry guidance.
